# Joshua Arncel Sierra

> Full-Stack Software Engineer & 4th-year BSIT Student based in Manila, Philippines. Specializing in modern web engineering, civic technologies, React, Next.js, React Native, Node.js, and cloud backends.

## Overview
Joshua Arncel Sierra (online alias: Watot12345) is a Full-Stack Software Engineer with 4+ years of practical software development experience. He creates resilient civic management platforms, real-world community portals, and mobile-ready web applications.

- **Name**: Joshua Arncel Sierra (also known as Joshua Sierra, Joshua A. Sierra)
- **Role**: Full-Stack Software Engineer
- **Location**: Manila / Quezon City, Philippines
- **Primary Website**: https://joshuasierra.vercel.app
- **Email**: joshuaarncel@gmail.com

## Key Projects
- **Civentral Web & Mobile** (https://civentral.tech):
  - Healthcare and Sanitation Management System built for local civic administration.
  - Web platform built with PHP, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase.
  - Mobile application built with React Native, Expo, and Supabase.
  - Role: Lead Developer.
- **SariSari App** (https://watot12345.github.io/sarisariApp/):
  - Lightweight inventory management and Point-of-Sale (POS) application designed specifically for neighborhood stores in the Philippines.
- **Barangay San Agustin Community Focus System** (https://barangay-san-agustin.onrender.com):
  - Community portal facilitating resident tracking, incident logging, and local administrative tasks.
- **SoleVerse Chronos** (https://sole-verse-chronos-main.vercel.app/):
  - E-commerce footwear catalog showcasing modern frontend architecture and responsive interactive UX.
- **Tenera Property Manager** (https://watot12345.github.io/Tenera/):
  - Offline-first mobile application built with Flutter for independent landlords and boarding house operators.
  - Powered by local SQLite Single Source of Truth (SSOT), Firebase sync, automated rent ledgers, and cash payment proof photo capture.
- **Roppets Entertainment Platform** (https://roppets.com):
  - Production web application for events and entertainment management.
